description: §17.1.1 if / else-if / else chain in the canonical `<program>` + `let <x/>` shape. @step seeds 1; two clicks advance it to 3, so the chain's FIRST true branch is the `else` (#rest): #one and #two are absent (count 0), not hidden. The bootstrap-gradable twin of control-flow/if-chain-inactive-branches-absent (that case is in the legacy rhs-decl shape). XFAIL on impl#1: it does not parse the §66 opener `let <step:number=1/>` (E-STATE-UNDECLARED; the runtime half throws `let is not defined`) — the opener half of the carried gap named below, not its §6.15 half; impl#1's chain itself is pinned by the legacy twin.
rationale: §17.1.1: "An if-chain desugars to a single `${ if / else if / else }` block in the containing markup context." and Example 1: "Only one span exists in the DOM at any time." At step 3 neither condition holds, so only the `else` member exists. Closes g-bootstrap-else-if-else-attrs-ignored (the bootstrap rendered every member).
